method: Cambridge publisher-owned search-index excerpts observed 2026-11-03. Direct Cambridge entry requests failed HTTP 403. Research leads are not human-independent signoff. Source URLs are preserved. Frozen shortlist unchanged. Original alternative examples authored for editorial consideration, not approval.

frozen.english_definition: To answer or react to a message, event, or action.
frozen.burmese_meaning: တုံ့ပြန်သည်
frozen.example_sentence: Please respond to the request by Friday.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge Learner's Dictionary indexes the intransitive answer/react sense at B2. The frozen example requires respond TO a request, not *respond a request*. Medical treatment response is a separate sense.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: To reply to something or react to what has happened.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ရာကို ပြန်လည်ဖြေကြားသည်၊ တုံ့ပြန်သည်
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: Please respond to the request by Friday.

frozen.english_definition: To organise and carry out an activity.
frozen.burmese_meaning: ဆောင်ရွက်သည်၊ ပြုလုပ်သည်
frozen.example_sentence: The team will conduct a safety inspection.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge labels the transitive organize-and-perform activity verb B2. Do not confuse with noun conduct /ˈkɒndʌkt/ (behaviour) or the electrical-conduction verb. George/Emma audio needs verb stress on second syllable.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: To organise and carry out a particular activity.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: စစ်ဆေးမှု၊ သုတေသန စသည့် လုပ်ငန်းတစ်ခုကို စီစဉ်ဆောင်ရွက်သည်
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: The team will conduct a safety inspection.

frozen.english_definition: Remaining at a similar standard or following the same pattern over time.
frozen.burmese_meaning: တစ်သမတ်တည်းဖြစ်သော
frozen.example_sentence: His results have been consistent throughout the year.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge indexes NOT CHANGING as C2, versus provisional B2. Frozen results-over-time definition and example appear aligned with this sense. Do not substitute unlabelled third-party B2 claims for Cambridge's C2 label. Separate 'consistent with' (AGREEING) sense also C2 on Cambridge.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: Staying at a similar level or following the same pattern over time.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: အချိန်ကြာလာသော်လည်း အရည်အသွေး သို့မဟုတ် ရလဒ် တစ်သမတ်တည်းရှိသော
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: Her performance has remained consistent throughout the year.

frozen.english_definition: To start an organisation or system intended to last.
frozen.burmese_meaning: တည်ထောင်သည်
frozen.example_sentence: The charity hopes to establish a new learning centre.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge START a company or organization intended to last is B2. The frozen definition also says 'system', which may broaden beyond that labelled sub-sense; human reviewer must confirm exact scope. 'Establish a relationship' is separately C1.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: To start an organisation that is intended to continue for a long time.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: ရေရှည်တည်တံ့ရန် ရည်ရွယ်သည့် အဖွဲ့အစည်းတစ်ခုကို တည်ထောင်သည်
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: The charity plans to establish a new learning centre.

frozen.english_definition: To happen, especially at a particular time or place.
frozen.burmese_meaning: ဖြစ်ပွားသည်၊ ဖြစ်ပေါ်သည်
frozen.example_sentence: Power cuts sometimes occur during heavy storms.

entries.editorial_risk: Cambridge labels intransitive HAPPEN B2, often accidents or unexpected events. Frozen power-cut example is natural. Spelling doubles r in occurring/occurred. 'Occur to someone' (thought) and EXIST senses are separate.

proposed_alternative.english_definition: To happen, especially unexpectedly or at a particular time.
proposed_alternative.burmese_meaning: အဖြစ်အပျက်တစ်ခု ဖြစ်ပေါ်သည်၊ ဖြစ်ပွားသည်
proposed_alternative.example_sentence: Power cuts sometimes occur during heavy storms.
